selected_evidence.summary: PID 4694 initially held audit.log; after unlink it showed a deleted descriptor. Following SIGHUP, the same PID used the new inode, had no deleted descriptor, and the line count continued increasing.

selected_evidence.requirement: SIGTERM closes the log and exits cleanly
selected_evidence.summary: The writer exited promptly, produced no traceback, and audit.log stopped growing.
archive/previous.log retained record A100 and SHA-1 5355b97cc10231092b2bf7bc7c31d12f66508a8d throughout testing and restart.

selected_evidence.requirement: Repair is compatible with the installed legacy platform
